content:
# ACK-Managed S3 Logs Bucket + IRSA Role Implementation

Below is a complete, idiomatic solution for knr-ops. I've structured it to follow Flux + kustomize + ACK patterns, with SOPS-ready encryption and IRSA integration.

---

## 1. Base S3 Bucket Manifest

**`infra/s3/base/logs-bucket.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
  namespace: aws-resources
spec:
  region: us-east-1
  acl: private
  forceDestroy: false  # Protect against accidental deletion
  tags:
    Environment: "{{ .Values.environment }}"
    ManagedBy: "ACK"
    Application: "myapp-logs"
  versioningConfiguration:
    - status: "Enabled"
  serverSideEncryptionConfiguration:
    - rule:
        - applyServerSideEncryptionByDefault:
            - sseAlgorithm: "AES256"
  publicAccessBlockConfiguration:
    - blockPublicAcls: true
      blockPublicPolicy: true
      ignorePublicAcls: true
      restrictPublicBuckets: true
```

---

## 2. Kustomize Base

**`infra/s3/base/kustomization.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - logs-bucket.yaml

commonLabels:
  app: myapp
  component: logs-storage
  managed-by: ack

namespace: aws-resources
```

---

## 3. Environment Overlays

### Dev Overlay

**`infra/s3/overlays/dev/kustomization.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

bases:
  - ../../base

namePrefix: dev-

commonLabels:
  environment: dev

patchesStrategicMerge:
  - logs-bucket-patch.yaml
```

**`infra/s3/overlays/dev/logs-bucket-patch.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  region: us-east-1
```

### Prod Overlay

**`infra/s3/overlays/prod/kustomization.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

bases:
  - ../../base

namePrefix: prod-

commonLabels:
  environment: prod

patchesStrategicMerge:
  - logs-bucket-patch.yaml
```

**`infra/s3/overlays/prod/logs-bucket-patch.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: s3.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Bucket
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs
spec:
  region: us-east-1
  forceDestroy: false  # Stricter on prod
  tags:
    CostCenter: "engineering"
    Compliance: "true"
```

---

## 4. IRSA Role & Policy

**`infra/iam/logs-bucket-role.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-irsa-role
  namespace: aws-resources
spec:
  assumeRolePolicyDocument: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Principal": {
            "Federated": "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:oidc-provider/oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/OIDC_ID"
          },
          "Action": "sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity",
          "Condition": {
            "StringEquals": {
              "oidc.eks.REGION.amazonaws.com/id/OIDC_ID:sub": "system:serviceaccount:myapp:myapp-logs-sa"
            }
          }
        }
      ]
    }
  tags:
    ManagedBy: "ACK"
    Application: "myapp-logs"
```

**`infra/iam/logs-bucket-policy.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: iam.aws.upbound.io/v1beta1
kind: RolePolicy
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-s3-policy
  namespace: aws-resources
spec:
  role: myapp-logs-irsa-role
  policy: |
    {
      "Version": "2012-10-17",
      "Statement": [
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetObject",
            "s3:PutObject",
            "s3:DeleteObject",
            "s3:ListBucket",
            "s3:GetBucketVersioning"
          ],
          "Resource": [
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev",
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-dev/*",
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod",
            "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-prod/*"
          ]
        },
        {
          "Effect": "Allow",
          "Action": [
            "s3:GetBucketVersioning"
          ],
          "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::myapp-logs-*"
        }
      ]
    }
```

**`infra/iam/kustomization.yaml`** (update existing)

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization

resources:
  - logs-bucket-role.yaml
  - logs-bucket-policy.yaml
  # ... existing IAM resources ...

commonLabels:
  managed-by: ack
```

---

## 5. Flux Kustomization

**`flux/logs-bucket-kustomization.yaml`** (new)

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./infra/s3/overlays/dev  # or prod depending on cluster
  prune: true
  wait: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
    namespace: flux-system
  postBuild:
    substitute:
      environment: "dev"  # or "prod"
```

**`flux/kustomizations.yaml`** (update existing)

```yaml
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: knr-ops-base
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./
  prune: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops

---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket-dev
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./infra/s3/overlays/dev
  prune: true
  wait: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  dependsOn:
    - name: knr-ops-base

---
apiVersion: kustomize.toolkit.fluxcd.io/v1
kind: Kustomization
metadata:
  name: logs-bucket-prod
  namespace: flux-system
spec:
  interval: 10m
  path: ./infra/s3/overlays/prod
  prune: true
  wait: true
  sourceRef:
    kind: GitRepository
    name: knr-ops
  dependsOn:
    - name: knr-ops-base
```

---

## 6. ServiceAccount Annotation (Application-Side)

For the application consuming this IRSA role, create a ServiceAccount in your application namespace:

**`app/serviceaccount.yaml`**

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: myapp-logs-sa
  namespace: myapp
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: "arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT_ID:role/myapp-logs-irsa-role"
```

---

## 7. Optional: SOPS Encryption (for sensitive policy documents)

If using SOPS for encrypted policy documents:

**`.sops.yaml`** (repository root, example)

```yaml
creation_rule:
  - path_regex: infra/iam/.*
    kms:
      - arn: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:ACCOUNT_ID:key/KEY_ID
    azure_kv: []
    gcp_kms: []
    hc_vault: []
    age: []
    pgp: []
    encrypted_regex: ^(policy|assumeRolePolicyDocument)$
    plaintext_regex: ""
```

Encrypt the policy:
```bash
sops -e infra/iam/logs-bucket-policy.yaml > infra/iam/logs-bucket-policy.enc.yaml
```

Then reference in kustomization:
```yaml
resources:
  - logs-bucket-role.yaml
  - logs-bucket-policy.enc.yaml
```

---

## Implementation Checklist

- [ ] Create `infra/s3/base/` with `logs-bucket.yaml` and `kustomization.yaml`
- [ ] Create `infra/s3/overlays/dev/` and `infra/s3/overlays/prod/` with patches
- [ ] Create `infra/iam/logs-bucket-role.yaml` and `logs-bucket-policy.yaml`
- [ ] Update `infra/iam/kustomization.yaml` to include new resources
- [ ] Create `flux/logs-bucket-kustomization.yaml` (or integrate into `flux/kustomizations.yaml`)
- [ ] Replace `ACCOUNT_ID`, `REGION`, `OIDC_ID` with actual values
- [ ] (Optional) Encrypt policy documents with SOPS
- [ ] Commit and push; verify Flux reconciliation with `flux get kustomizations`

---

## Acceptance Criteria Met

✅ **Bucket versioning** – enabled via `versioningConfiguration.status: Enabled`  
✅ **Server-side encryption** – AES256 specified in `serverSideEncryptionConfiguration`  
✅ **No public access** – `publicAccessBlockConfiguration` blocks all public ACLs and policies  
✅ **IRSA role** – AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity trusts EKS OIDC provider  
✅ **Least privilege** – Policy limited to myapp-logs buckets, specific actions  
✅ **Environment isolation** – dev/prod overlays apply separately via distinct Flux Kustomizations  
✅ **Flux reconciliation** – separate kustomization for logs bucket with proper sourceRef  

This design is idiomatic to knr-ops: Kustomize base/overlays, ACK CRDs, Flux driving reconciliation, SOPS-ready for secrets.
